objective: Audit recent activation history and frontier decisions to determine whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection produces better information flow.
bottleneck: Prior activations had durable conclusions but task choice was opportunistic from a queue.
question: Does the current focused-task selector improve learning efficiency relative to the repository's prior opportunistic task choice?
action: Audited the controller selector implementation (.github/scripts/campaign_controller.py::task_rank / candidate_tasks_for_role / select_task), the single persisted selection record (campaign_status.json), the full durable task queue (state/campaign/task_queue.json, P-001..P-006 / R-001..R-005), state/LEARNING_STATE.md, state/STATE.md, state/activation_status.json, REPOSITORY_PLAYBOOK.md, and the recent activation records (logs/ACTIVATION-2026-10-02..10-06). Compared pre-campaign (opportunistic) task-choice behavior against the current controller-selected task-choice behavior and classified whether better information flow is evidenced.
changed: state/campaign/runs/45085425994/agents/agent_01.json (this activation record; no research code or controller files modified)
unverified: No code, test, command, or computation was executed this activation: the bash tool is denied at this layer (project permission), so all verification is by direct inspection of durable artifacts only. This is an execution-environment constraint, not a research result.

task_rank is a fixed lexicographic ordinal over seven qualitative dimensions (expected_information_gain, downstream_leverage, falsification_power, verifiability, effort, complexity, execution_risk) plus task_id, not a validated efficiency rule; whether it is the correct ordering cannot be falsified from a single selection.

The agent output schema lacks any explicit task-selection trace (no candidate set, no compared_against, no post-hoc value observation), so future agents cannot record whether the task they received was the highest-value option.

The causal magnitude of any efficiency improvement cannot be separated from concurrent process changes (frontier-first selection, independent verifier pattern, novelty guard) over the same activations; only an association can be assessed, not an isolated selector effect.
Only one campaign exists to date (run 45085425994, campaign slot 01), so the controller-level selector has one persisted selection observation and no completed pre/post campaign pair.
observed_effect: Convergent but non-independent evidence that explicit selection produced a measurable change in task-choice behavior and information flow. (1) Pre-campaign contrast is documented: LEARNING_STATE records that activation 37260572520 selected its objective 'from a queued receipt item rather than a frontier cell' and was therefore logged as UNVERIFIED for the process delta; the campaign task_queue.json is now explicitly built around one bounded task per agent with a qualitative-priority selection principle. (2) No duplicate frontier cell among the six recent research activations: 37263008074 mean-reversion -> 37304873966 cross-sectional relative strength -> 37314710995 volatility targeting -> 37318950814 momentum -> 37361000967 momentum lookback sweep (new diagnostic purpose: parameter robustness) -> 37394344201 longer-horizon (20/60) -> 37414038601 breakout continuation (new signal class). Each is recorded as closing with a decisive verdict; the two momentum-touching cells are separated by a new hypothesis/horizon objective, so they are not equivalent retests. (3) Every one of those cells has an independent verifier path (verify_*.py) or independent recomputation recorded as MATCH in state/activation_status.json and LEARNING_STATE. (4) The controller selection record is consistent with the stated ranking: campaign_status.json selection_history shows P-001 compared_against [P-001,P-002,P-004,P-003,P-006] and selected for agent 01; for LEARNING_PROCESS OPEN tasks the top rank is (HIGH,HIGH,HIGH,HIGH,LOW,LOW,LOW) shared by P-001/P-002/P-004/P-003, with task_id tie-break yielding P-001. However, these activations predate the controller selector, so they evidence the frontier-first process delta, not the controller selection code; only an association, not an isolated selector effect, is supported. Net: explicit selection did not worsen information flow and co-occurs with a clean, duplicate-free, independently-verified sequence, but the durable record cannot attribute that flow to the selector alone, and the selector itself is not auditable from agent records.
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection (vs the prior opportunistic queue choice) yields better information flow, and whether the selector is auditable from durable records.
uncertainty_reduced: Partially. Established by inspection that (a) the repository changed from opportunistic to explicit selection, (b) the six recent frontier cells contain no exact duplicate and each has an independent verification path, and (c) the current selection record is consistent with the declared ordinal ranking. Not resolved: an isolated selector effect and any comparison across multiple campaigns, because only one campaign exists and agent records carry no selection trace.
research_result: No research hypothesis was tested; this is a LEARNING_PROCESS judgment. The assessed object is the task-selection mechanism, not a market, asset, or dataset.
next: Have a later LEARNING_PROCESS activation (campaign slot 03 or 05) re-audit after at least two additional campaigns complete, comparing (i) duplicate rate and (ii) independently-verified closure rate of selected tasks against the pre-campaign opportunistic baseline, and record the selection trace in the agent record so the comparison is auditable.

candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does requiring a task-selection trace in the agent record make the selector auditable enough to compare selected-task value across campaigns?
candidate_tasks.bottleneck: Agent records omit the candidate set and compared_against, so the controller selector's choices cannot be audited or falsified from durable records.
candidate_tasks.objective: Specify and, if permitted by scope, implement one minimal additive selection-trace field in the agent record schema and verify it preserves existing validation.
candidate_tasks.scope: Inspect controller validation and one agent record; propose at most one minimal schema addition.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not redesign the controller, add a numeric reward score, or modify protected files.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A bounded schema recommendation with a verification path.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The recommendation is classified as implementable-with-verification or rejected-with-reason.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop when the single trace-field recommendation is classified.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Controller-side schema validation plus inspection of the affected agent record.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: This activation found the agent output schema carries no selection trace.

candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does the fixed task_rank ordinal ever select a task that a fresh qualitative review would judge lower-value, on the current OPEN queue?
candidate_tasks.bottleneck: The selector is a fixed lexicographic ordinal over seven dimensions; a single ordering rule may systematically mis-rank tasks whose value is context-dependent.
candidate_tasks.objective: Independently re-derive the top-3 LEARNING_PROCESS and top-3 HIGHER_ORDER_OBJECTIVE tasks by qualitative judgment and compare against task_rank output on the current queue.
candidate_tasks.scope: Use the durable queue and controller ranking only; no code changes.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not redesign the controller or add scoring.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A bounded comparison classifying selector ordering as adequate or mis-ranking.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The ranking comparison yields a clear adequate/mis-ranking classification.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop when the comparison is complete.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Independent inspection of the queue and the controller ranking function.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: task_rank is a fixed ordinal and has been exercised on one selection only.
